purpose: The decorative divider between Breadcrumb items, drawn as a chevron, a slash or a dot. Not for standalone use.

notFor.case: Used on its own, outside a Breadcrumb.
Dividing items of a joined button row.

Default.visual: Chevron, slash or dot glyph in Content/subtle, sized like the items.

notes: role="presentation" and aria-hidden: it carries no information.
